svg.text: REFLECTOR ARC LENGTH — 12 inches per side
A: intersection with the cradle’s outer edge → B: top inside edge of the rib
A → B, ALONG THE RED CURVE
A is where the red curve meets
the outside of the U-shaped cradle.
at the top edge of the rib.
Highlighted curve: current model v12 ideal reflector guide, from cradle intersection to rib tip.
This is an arc length, following the curve; no attachment allowance is included.
